visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar (#143950 and #667b8a), which may cause visual confusion.
The dock color (#98734e) is close to the ground color (#283e35), potentially leading to misinterpretation of elements in the district.

navigationRisks.description: Route path includes a sudden change from row 17 to row 40, which might be confusing for players navigating through the district.
The route does not have any clear landmarks or visual cues between certain points (e.g., between rows 52 and 64), making navigation difficult.
